verdict.rationale: Kick ships built-in automated AI categorization (97% first-pass, auto-updating P&L) plus an AI/MCP layer that lets external assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, custom tools) query transactions, generate reports, and execute bookkeeping changes with approval. However, this is delivered via MCP/CLI connectors to third-party assistants rather than a single unified 'built-in assistant' persona inside the product UI, and there's no first-party independent hands-on validation of the assistant's reliability. missing for 10: evidence of a native in-app chat/assistant UI (not just MCP connectors to external AI tools), independent/third-party verification of the AI assistant's task delegation working end-to-end.
